PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 140
PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 140
ACT XXIV OF 2021
QARSHI UNIVERSITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2021
An Act to amend the Qarshi University,
Muridke Act, 2011
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
5th August, 2021]
No.
PAP/Legis-3(613)/2021/2593, dated 5.8.2021.---The Qarshi University (Amendment) Bill 2021, having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on August 03. 2021 and assented to by the
Governor of the Punjab on August 05, 2021, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Qarshi University, Muridke Act 2011 (XIV of 2011)
in the manner hereinafter appearing;
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of
the Punjab as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be cited as the Qarshi University (Amendment) Act, 2021.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

General amendment in Act XIV of 2011

Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of

2. General
amendment in Act XIV of 2011.---In
the Qarshi University, Muridke Act, 2011 (XIV of 2011), for brevity cited as
'the Act', the expression ", Muridke", wherever occur, shall be
omitted and the word "Society", wherever occur, shall be substituted
by the words "Qarshi Foundation".

the Act, in section 2:
(i) after
clause (n), the following new clause (nn) shall be added:
"(nn)
"Qarshi Foundation" means the trust established under the Trusts Act
2020 (XXI of 2020), the sponsoring body of the University;" and
(ii) clause
(r) shall be omitted.

the Act, in section 3, for subsection (1), the following shall be substituted:

in section 4 of Act XlV of 2011.---In
the Act, in section 4, in clause (a), for sub-clauses (i) and (ii), the
following shall be substituted:
"(i) the Faculties of Medicine, Eastern Medicine and Allied Health
Sciences, Computer Sciences and Information Technology, Social and Management
Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Engineering and Technology, Sciences and
Arts and Humanities; and
(ii) such
other branches of knowledge, as the Board may determine with the approval of
the Chancellor given on the recommendation of a committee constituted by the
Board and, where applicable, subject to the prior approval of the relevant
statutory body of a professional education;"
